title: Workbench presentation text
note: Every string a person reads that is not domain data, lifted verbatim from the frozen control-behavior record and the runtime that reproduced it. Values come from the scene contract, the camera and the run; only their phrasing comes from here. Swapping this pack changes wording, punctuation or language without touching a component identity, a binding or a scene.
